name: Hauser & Wirth Menorca
description: One of the world's most influential art galleries chose an islet in Maó harbour for its first Mediterranean home: part of the old naval hospital on Illa del Rei, restored by architect Luis Laplace, with eight galleries, an open-air sculpture trail and a garden by landscape designer Piet Oudolf (of New York's High Line). You arrive by boat from the harbour. The most exclusive art outing in the Balearics, and it's open to everyone.

practicalInfo.acceso: Illa del Rei, Maó harbour; regular boats and water taxi from the port.
practicalInfo.horario: Season and hours on the official website; closed in winter.
practicalInfo.servicios: Eight exhibition rooms, sculpture trail (Chillida, Miró...), Piet Oudolf garden, cantina and shop.

seo.description: Hauser & Wirth Menorca, Illa del Rei: the international gallery in Maó harbour, with a Piet Oudolf garden. By boat.

imageAlt: Aerial view of Illa del Rei, with the former military hospital, in the middle of the natural harbour of Maó, Menorca.
